requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet evolving customer usage needs and remain competitive with high-yield consumables, especially in SMB and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with CISS, IDS, and ink tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be keyed, support 6K black and 8K+ CMY page yields, and be compatible with printer system; performance validated in yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure that the new ink bottles and filling system are spill-free to improve user experience and reduce mess during refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free design is critical for consumer satisfaction and to differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank interface design, IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink filling process must not result in any ink spillages in normal use; verified by user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Non-Original Accessory Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, retaining click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security, reliability, and warranty support, and prevents unauthorized use of non-HP supplies.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, integration with printer hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must have metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, retain click-on push-push and TDF; validated in reliability and security tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: The product must reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks, with no ink reformulation required.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, leverages proven consumables, and supports supply chain efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks work seamlessly in the new system without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Develop comprehensive reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) scenarios. Include ink stability modeling for tank and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Critical for ensuring long-term product performance and warranty claims management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models completed, validated with test data, and reviewed by QA; ink stability meets or exceeds PQ standards over product life.

requirements.Title: Support for Services and Contractual NOA-F Parts
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty support, and the system must support services/contractual models.
requirements.Rationale: Enables serviceability and supports HP’s business model for extended warranty and service contracts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts available in service inventory; service process documented and validated.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for New Components
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 factory line for NOA-F integration, and add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5. Provide new molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Required to manufacture and assemble the new product components efficiently and at scale.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design finalization, factory tooling schedules.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new components; molds for new caps in production.

requirements.Title: Page Yield and Warranty Life Goals
requirements.Description: Support new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages and SuperAmp PHA life at 65,000 pages. Warranty period is 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with business priorities to reduce service costs and meet market expectations for reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers must reliably print 80,000 pages over 2 years; SuperAmp PHA must last 65,000 pages; validated by life testing.

requirements.Title: Speed and Throughput Requirements
requirements.Description: Product must achieve print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language), with PDL throughput of 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To remain competitive and meet customer expectations for productivity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers consistently achieve 25/20 ppm (25/19 PDL) in standardized test conditions.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system such that PHA and NOA-F are customer replaceable, improving ease of maintenance and reducing service calls.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Product ID and Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with increased tank size. No change to Marconi-HI ADF (Automatic Document Feeder).
requirements.Rationale: Tank size increase supports higher page yield and reduces refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product ID and tank size changes reflected in production units; tank supports required page yields.

requirements.Title: Packaging and Environmental Compliance
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging, ensure EPEAT3 and LOT4 compliance, and Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory requirements and supports HP’s sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging meets EPS, EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards; certifications obtained.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray and Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Update input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize overall product size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and optimizes product footprint for customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit and function with new tank; overall product size optimized and validated.

requirements.Title: 4.3-inch CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphics Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and accessibility, supporting modern UI expectations.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UI/UX Team
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3-inch CGD display functional and passes usability/user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage a four-tube platform using Sayan Sibstar tubes, with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Supports efficient ink delivery and reliability for increased page life.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, integration with IDS and ink tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube system implemented, tested for reliability and flow rate.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management and spit platform to accommodate changes due to the larger tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system prevents contamination; validated in long-term testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Updates
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Updated models reviewed and validated by engineering; no mechanical failures in testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life and reliability goals.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new warranty and page yield requirements, reducing jams and wear.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes reliability testing for 80,000 pages without significant jams or wear.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Enables post-warranty servicing and extends product lifespan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part replaceable at service centers; process documented and validated.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection in the IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of ink delivery system.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and tank design, component integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New IDS connections implemented and validated in system integration testing.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to support larger tanks and new ink system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable system startup and prevents air-related print defects.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS algorithm development, tank and tube design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management validated in system testing; no startup failures or air-related defects.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with increased page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures that print quality is maintained throughout the extended product life and yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics defined, validated in life testing, and documented.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL, Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven hardware modules to reduce risk and development time.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components reused without issues; system integration tests pass.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Provides wireless connectivity and firmware platform continuity.
requirements.Dependencies: Module and firmware integration, compliance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware operate reliably and pass regulatory and user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product security and compliance with HP security standards.
requirements.Dependencies: HW and FW development, security validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features implemented and pass internal security audits.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS (Printing as a Service), WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths. Support scan solution, SMB manageability, and Enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports multiple customer segments and deployment models.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Business Operations, Channel Partners
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business models and solution paths functional and documented; onboarding validated for each segment.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for seamless installation and operation.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with HP’s ecosystem and customer IT environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients install and operate successfully on supported platforms.

requirements.Title: Schedule and Checkpoint Adherence
requirements.Description: Adhere to defined hardware, NOA-F, and bottle checkpoints and build milestones (e.g., Re-SI, DO, IL, DP, MC, VR, FCS, BB1, BB2, TR, LP1, LP2, MP1/PP, SOR).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely program execution and risk management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints and builds completed as per schedule; deviations documented and addressed.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure maintenance box is easily serviceable to optimize service operations and customer experience.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service process documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced/replaced by service personnel; validated by serviceability testing.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Support for hosting 12,000-page CMYK and trade page 6,000, as a flexible business requirement.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for future scalability and market responsiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System design allows for 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page options if required by business.
